mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate environment compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0% (as of t-1mo), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers market expectations of aggressive Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% (y/y), or directional signal fails t-test (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month moving averages, or interaction term is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) accelerates wage growth and inflation expectations, triggering Fed tightening that causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5%, or directional signal lacks statistical significance (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing output and economic momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through near-term earnings support.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises month-over-month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,650,000 annualized units signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1650.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) signal active monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%, or interaction effect is insignificant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.5%) during expansion phases supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
